name: The Curse of Eira
storyline: Wynn and Eira are twin sisters who are cursed to be unable to die. When they were still very little Eira killed their parents Wynn manage to escape, but swore one day she would find Eira and kill her for what she did. Wynn heard rumors of an orange girl with Red eyes in the kingdom of Alara working for a powerful Wizard. Wynn ventured to the kingdom to find her twin sister Eira so she could kill her
summary: The Curse of Eira is a metroidvania where the main character is unable to die, but each time she is knocked out she gets back up weaker with slower movement speed small jump heights and smaller attack range
